newsitem.title: UK: Nynex CableComms revamps strategy - report.
newsitem.headline: Nynex CableComms revamps strategy - report.

text.p: Nynex Cable Communications Group Plc is set to introduce a new programme strategy next week in an effort to boost its subscription rate, according to a report published on Tuesday.
The Daily Telegraph said the cable television company is understook to have designed new packages that are very different from the typical multi-channel offerings.

"Analysts have been briefed, however, on Nynex's new plan, which is understood to cover five broad categories of programming," the newspaper said. The five categories include sports, movies and documentary and historical packages, the paper reported.
